name: Multi-SKU Multi-Site Disruption
description: Disruption across multiple SKUs (SKU-1001, SKU-1002) affecting both Chennai Plant SITE-CHN-01 and Bengaluru Plant SITE-BLR-02.
report_text: MULTI-SITE ALERT: Power surge at Bharat Power Semi Ltd (SUP-002) and Apex Micro Systems (SUP-001) halted deliveries of SKU-1001 and SKU-1002 to both Chennai Plant (SITE-CHN-01) and Bengaluru Plant (SITE-BLR-02) for 9 days. Severity: 4.
test_purpose: Scalability of blackboard: multi-item and multi-site extraction and parallel resolution.
